reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse any statement of a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure that alters the value of a control data item of any report: a store into the item, a group containing it, an item subordinate to it, or any other data item sharing its storage (a REDEFINES of it or of a record that contains it, a RENAMES of it), by every storing verb.

reader.notes: Every storing verb into the control item, its containing group, a subordinate, its condition-name, a RENAMES of it, and another report's control item is refused (COBOL2378). A store through a REDEFINES alias - of the control item itself or of the record that holds it - is not related to the control item, because SameStorageLine walks only the Parent chain, so the procedure alters the control data item and compiles clean. The 1985 text itself treats 'a redefinition or renaming of any part of a control data item' as touching it (XIII.3.20.3 SR5 c).
